alternatives.argument: Its complete local proof constructs the boost taking e0 to Lambda e0, proves the residual spatial map lies in SO(3), and derives the axis-angle form; the item records every Euclidean, hyperbolic, determinant and continuity premise.

This is a local mathematical definition, not a borrowed theorem: it fixes the Pauli blocks, Fourier and shell conventions, projections, conjugate Hilbert space and W_D. No source argument is needed to establish a definition.

Its complete local proof multiplies the explicit Pauli blocks, proves complementary rank-two orthogonal projectors, establishes the maximal multiplier self-adjoint domain, and verifies rotation, boost and W_D identities.

Its complete conditional proof constructs u_F with Schwartz estimates, expands the actual fermionic CAR, proves the tested equation and equal-time relation, and derives the spinor causal kernel by differentiating the supplied scalar causal distribution.

Its complete local proof builds the product-L2 sector PVM componentwise, proves maximal real-multiplier self-adjointness on the antisymmetric direct sum, and verifies cone, vacuum, gap and exact generator claims.

Its complete conditional proof transforms positive and negative shell kernels separately, extends the test action by a proved dense-range argument, constructs the exterior-Fock unitary, and checks covariance, continuity, cyclicity and 2pi/4pi action.
Its complete verification evaluates h_D(0), omega(0), and the two projectors at mu>0; it supplies an orthonormal basis for each fiber range and excludes any continuum L2 point-state claim.
